name: Vibe Building Skills
headline: Vibe Building Skills - Build SaaS and Mobile Apps
short_description: A collection of 32 skills for Claude to build and ship SaaS and mobile apps. Covers marketing, creative assets, and frontend design. Helps operations teams create products that resonate with users.
author: sanky369

sections.overview:
Vibe Building Skills is a comprehensive system of 36 agent skills designed to help teams build world-class digital products. It includes one product strategy skill using the Foundation Sprint method, twelve marketing skills covering direct response, SEO, email, and social media, ten creative skills for AI-powered asset generation, and thirteen frontend design skills for design systems and UI excellence. The system provides production-ready guidance for product strategy, marketing positioning, content creation, visual design, and interface implementation, helping operations teams and product builders create products that resonate with users.
Evaluating and pressure-testing product ideas before committing resources
Building complete marketing strategies from positioning through content atomization
Generating professional creative assets and visual identities with AI
Designing and implementing accessible, responsive frontend systems
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/sanky369/vibe-building-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a 30-day marketing plan for a new [PRODUCT_TYPE] app targeting [TARGET_AUDIENCE]. Include a mix of organic and paid strategies, with a focus on building a strong brand vibe. Allocate a budget of [BUDGET] and prioritize channels that align with [BRAND_PERSONALITY].
```
Copy

```
Here's a 30-day marketing plan for 'Zenith', a new productivity app targeting busy professionals aged 25-40 who value minimalism and efficiency. We'll focus on building a sleek, high-energy brand vibe with a $10,000 budget. Week 1-2: Organic content on LinkedIn and Twitter, showcasing productivity tips and behind-the-scenes app development. Week 3-4: Launch a targeted LinkedIn ad campaign, retargeting website visitors with a 15% discount. Throughout the month, engage with productivity influencers for potential collaborations. Allocate $3,000 for ads, $2,000 for influencer outreach, and $5,000 for content creation and design.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
